detection.calibration: maximum score per permutation; familywise empirical cutoff

limitations: Weak bias baseline; no claim of gain over R9.
Fixed random geometry, not learned K1 taste factors.
Retrospective training-only interactions; no Probe labels or identities.
Small permutation budget; shifted placebo support may differ.

input_manifest.baseline: fresh regularized user/item biases; weaker than R9-LAT-A2h
input_manifest.split: seeded row split 60% upstream / 20% residual / 10% inner / 10% outer
input_manifest.geometry: fixed seeded random item vectors; rating independent
input_manifest.gate: full RMSE beats base, smooth, bias and placebo by >=0.0001
input_manifest.budget: 500 users by default, 19 permutations; no upstream checkpoint training

reason: Full correction worsened outer RMSE and coverage is too small to justify larger training under this bounded configuration.
movie_id_convention: Event table uses zero-based item indices; original Netflix movie ID is movie+1. Window start/end are integer dataset-day // 7, end exclusive.
